direct.docTitle: Likwiid Direct: Commission-Free Direct Booking Engine
direct.heroTitle: Bookings that flow straight to you.
direct.heroSubtitle: Likwiid Direct is a commission-free direct booking engine for small stays and experiences. No middleman, no lock-in. You keep your domain, your payment account and your guest list.
direct.audience: Built for small hotels, guesthouses, tour operators, salons and clinics.
direct.demoNote: Quinta Likwiid and Atelier Likwiid are fictional. They exist so you can click through the exact engine we would build for you. The checkout is simulated and no payment is taken.
direct.feature1Desc: A tasting for two, an airport transfer, an extra night. Guests tick what they want and watch the total and the deposit update in front of them.
direct.feature2Title: A deposit, not the full amount
direct.feature2Desc: Most small properties already ask for 20 or 30 percent by bank transfer. Likwiid Direct takes the same deposit by card, at the exact moment the guest decides, and the balance stays payable on arrival.
direct.feature3Title: It lives inside the site you already have
direct.feature3Desc: It goes on the website you already have, whether it is WordPress, Wix or hand-built, and we install it for you. No rebuild, no migration. Your website stays yours and the bookings come straight to you.
direct.feature4Desc: Every step, every label and every price in the language the guest picks. Nothing half translated and nothing leaking internal labels.
direct.feature5Title: Places left, and a waitlist when a slot is full
direct.feature5Desc: Classes, tours and sessions carry a capacity per time. Guests see how many places are left, and when a slot is full they can join the waitlist instead of leaving.
direct.feature6Title: Your rules, applied before anyone asks
direct.feature6Desc: Minimum and maximum stays, the notice you need, days kept free between bookings, seasonal prices and closed periods. The calendar only offers what you would accept.
direct.feature7Title: Your terms, agreed before anything is sent
direct.feature7Desc: Your cancellation and payment terms sit at the last step, and nobody can book or send a request without ticking that they have read them.
direct.feature8Title: An owner panel in your brand
direct.feature8Desc: Requests to approve or decline, a reservation list with search and export, a calendar you block with one click, your guests and their credits, and your texts and prices. You edit all of it yourself.
direct.segmentsIntro: Independent places that would rather take bookings themselves than pay a platform a commission on each one.

segments.desc: Guests pick their dates, add breakfast or a transfer, and pay a deposit or send you a request.

segments.title: Small hotels

segments.title: Experiences like padel courts or dive trips

direct.marketLinksTitle: Pages for your kind of business
direct.scarcity: Our first live booking page is the one we built for Escuela Náutica de Valencia. Likwiid Direct is the same idea packaged for stays, and it has no paying property yet. So the first one gets the lower end of the price, in exchange for letting us show the result. If a platform already serves you well and the commission does not bother you, this product is not for you.
direct.demoPreviewAlt: Preview of the Likwiid Direct booking flow
direct.syncBody: Likwiid Direct imports the busy dates from the calendars you already use. Any platform that can export an iCal feed works, and those dates close here automatically. It also exports a feed for each unit, so a direct booking closes the date everywhere else you list. In the live demo the synced calendar is sample data. Syncs are not instant: feeds refresh on a schedule, and the calendar shows when it last synced, so you always know how fresh the busy dates are.
direct.requestBody: Likwiid Direct runs in request mode for owners who confirm every booking themselves. A visitor picks dates, party size and extras, sees an estimated total, and sends it to you. Nothing is booked and no payment is taken. The enquiry arrives with everything you would otherwise have to ask for, and you confirm, suggest another time or decline, exactly as you do today.
direct.requestNote: When you want bookings to confirm themselves, switch to instant booking with a card deposit from your owner panel. Same page, same calendar.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.collectBody: When you use our contact form, we collect the information you provide: your name, email address, company name (if provided), and message content. We do not collect any information automatically beyond what is strictly necessary for the website to function.
privacy.useBody: We use the information you submit through our contact form solely to respond to your inquiry and discuss potential projects. We will not send you marketing communications unless you have explicitly opted in to receive them.
privacy.sharingBody: We do not sell, trade, or share your personal information with third parties. Your data stays with us and is used exclusively for the purpose it was provided.
privacy.cookiesBody: We only use essential browser storage. We keep your theme preference, light or dark, and your language choice in localStorage, and during a single visit we keep any campaign tags from the link you followed in sessionStorage. We do not use any tracking cookies or third-party cookies.
privacy.analyticsBody: We use privacy-friendly analytics, Umami, hosted on our own server, that do not use cookies and do not track personal data. We count page views and clicks on buttons such as the contact button or a demo launch, and we honour your browser's Do Not Track setting. If you arrive through a link with campaign tags, we keep those tags and the page you landed on in your browser's sessionStorage for the length of your visit, and send them with the contact form so we know how you found us. Nothing in this identifies you, and your browsing is not tracked across websites.
privacy.appsBody: Our free, open source apps BaseMile and PlateClimb have no account, no server, no analytics and no ads. Everything you record, such as workouts, sets, runs, heart rate, routes and settings, is stored only on your phone. We never receive it, and deleting the app deletes it. Android cloud backup is switched off for both apps, and neither app uses Apple Health.
privacy.appsBasemile: BaseMile uses your location during a run to measure distance, pace and your route, Bluetooth to read your heart rate strap, and motion data to measure cadence. To show weather and elevation it sends the approximate location of your run to Open-Meteo, which you can switch off in Settings. Map tiles load from OpenFreeMap, which sees which map area is shown. If you export a run as a GPX file, it goes only where you choose to share it.
privacy.appsPlateclimb: PlateClimb loads exercise photos from GitHub, and the form video links open YouTube when you tap them. Like any website, these services see your IP address when the request is made. Nothing else leaves your phone.
privacy.appsSource: The source code of both apps is public, so you can check all of this yourself:
privacy.retentionBody: Contact form submissions are retained for legitimate business purposes, such as maintaining records of client communications and project discussions. We keep this data only as long as necessary for these purposes.
privacy.rightsBody: You have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of any personal data we hold about you. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at
privacy.updatesBody: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected on this page with an updated revision date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
privacy.contactBody: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or how we handle your data, please reach out at

ota.name: OTA commission calculator
ota.docTitle: OTA Commission Calculator for Hotels | Likwiid
ota.heroTitle: What do booking platforms really cost you?
ota.heroSubtitle: Enter your own numbers to see the commission you pay online travel agencies (OTAs) each year, and what you would keep by moving some of those guests to direct bookings.
ota.bookingsHint: All channels together. If you think in nights, enter nights per year here and the average nightly rate below.
ota.valueHint: What a guest pays for one booking, before any commission.
ota.shareHint: Booking platforms that charge you a commission on each reservation.
ota.commissionHint: The rate in your contract. With several platforms, enter an average.
ota.visibilityHint: Percentage points some platforms add for better placement. Leave empty if you do not use one.
ota.processingHint: The card fee you would pay on a direct booking, so the saving is not overstated.
ota.shiftLabel: Share of OTA bookings moved to direct
ota.commissionResult: Commission paid to OTAs each year
ota.keepResult: Kept each year by moving {{shift}} to direct
ota.keepNote: The commission you would no longer pay on those bookings.
ota.keepNoteFees: {{saved}} of commission no longer paid, minus {{fees}} of payment processing.
ota.rangeTitle: Kept each year at other shares
ota.howBody1: Commission each year = bookings per year × average booking value × share through OTAs × (commission rate + visibility extra).
ota.howBody2: Kept each year = the OTA revenue you move to direct × (commission rate + visibility extra, minus payment processing).
ota.howBody3: The result leaves out what it costs to win those direct bookings, such as your website, a booking engine or marketing. Weigh those against it.
ota.ratesNote: As of October 2026, OTA commission is commonly 15% to 18%, and higher with visibility programmes. The rate in your own contract is the one that counts.
ota.ctaBody: Likwiid Direct is a commission-free booking engine inside your own website, for guesthouses, small hotels and experiences, with deposits, options and waitlists.

openSource.docTitle: Open Source Apps: BaseMile, PlateClimb and WOOP | Likwiid
openSource.title: Free apps you can read, change and keep
openSource.intro: We think software should be free: free to use, to read, to change and to share. Plenty of paid apps and suites can be replaced by open tools that do the same job without a subscription. These apps started as tools for our own training and planning. They are now open source under the GPL, for anyone to use.
openSource.principle1Body: GPL licensed. Read the code, fork it and ship your own version, as long as it stays open.
openSource.principle2Body: Your data stays on your phone, and every app works offline.
openSource.principle3Body: No sign up, no analytics, no ads.

basemile.pitch: A Zone 2 running coach that builds your aerobic base, one easy run at a time.
basemile.body: BaseMile covers the cardio days of the Foundational Fitness week: Long, Medium and Brief runs, coached by heart rate so easy days stay easy, then turned into trends that show your aerobic base growing week by week.
basemile.feature1: Long, Medium and Brief runs, with targets from your own heart rate and a MAF ceiling on easy days
basemile.feature2: Live heart rate from any standard Bluetooth strap, tested with the Garmin HRM-Dual
basemile.feature3: A voice coach that runs on the phone and speaks up when you drift out of zone
basemile.feature4: Route maps, pace, MAF trends and training load after every run, with no account and your data kept on the phone
basemile.note: BaseMile is an independent project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Andrew Huberman or Huberman Lab.

plateclimb.pitch: The Foundational Fitness week from Huberman's Protocols, as a free workout app that runs offline.
plateclimb.body: PlateClimb runs one 12 week plan built on the weekly structure Andrew Huberman describes in Protocols: legs, torso, and shoulders and arms days between long, medium and intense cardio. Log your sets and it fills in the weights for next time. Your workouts stay on the phone.
plateclimb.feature1: Two six and five week blocks, heavier then higher reps, followed by a week off
plateclimb.feature2: Sets, reps, rest and effort targets for every lift, with swaps when a machine is taken
plateclimb.feature3: Weights filled in from your last session, with a photo and a video link for each exercise
plateclimb.feature4: No account and no server: your workouts stay on your phone
plateclimb.note: PlateClimb is an independent project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Andrew Huberman or Huberman Lab.

woop.pitch: A calm planner for WOOP, the four step method that turns a wish into an if-then plan.
woop.body: WOOP walks you through Wish, Outcome, Obstacle and Plan, the mental contrasting method from Gabriele Oettingen's research that Andrew Huberman covers in Protocols. Each obstacle gets an if-then plan, and short check-ins help you tune it when it does not work. The app has no internet permission, so your WOOPs never leave the phone.
woop.feature1: One question per screen, with autosave, voice input and examples on tap
woop.feature2: An if-then plan for each obstacle, with the one you focus on in a home screen widget
woop.feature3: Reminders to write a WOOP, and one minute check-ins that tune the plan
woop.feature4: A Science tab that rates the evidence behind each step, and no streaks or scores
woop.note: WOOP is an independent project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Gabriele Oettingen, WOOP My Life, Andrew Huberman or Huberman Lab. It is a self-help tool, not treatment.

openSource.disclaimer: Not medical advice. Check with a professional before you start a new training program.
openSource.contributeBody: All three apps are on GitHub. Bug reports, translations and pull requests are welcome, and so are forks. If you use one of them, tell us what works and what does not.

faq.costA: A booking page added to the website you already have costs EUR 300 to 600, once. A complete new website with booking built in costs EUR 900 to 1,700, once. There is no commission and no monthly fee to Likwiid. You get the exact price in writing before anything starts.
faq.siteQ: Do I need a new website?
faq.siteA: No. The booking page goes on the website you already have, and we install it for you. If you have no website, or you want a new one, we build that too.
faq.afterQ: Who looks after it after launch?
faq.afterA: The same person who built it. You write to Gabriel by WhatsApp or email and get an answer within 24 hours. Any change you ask for later is priced in writing before the work starts.
faq.payQ: How and when do I pay?
faq.payA: You pay a share when we agree, and the balance only when your page is live. If it does not go live, you do not pay the balance.
faq.platformQ: A booking platform already works for me. Do I need this?
faq.platformA: If a platform already serves you well and the commission does not bother you, this is not for you. A booking page on your own website is for the guests who already look for you directly.
faq.moneyQ: How does the money reach my account?
faq.moneyA: Card payments go into a payment account opened in your own name, for example Stripe. The money goes from the guest to you. Likwiid never holds it.
faq.stopQ: What happens if I stop working with you?
faq.stopA: The page, the bookings and the guest list are yours and they stay with you. Your domain and your payment account are in your name from the first day.
faq.termsQ: Do guests see my cancellation terms before they book?
faq.termsA: Yes. Your cancellation and payment terms sit at the last step, and nobody can book or send a request without ticking that they have read them.
faq.languageQ: Does it work in my guests' language?
faq.languageA: Yes. Every step, every label and every price is shown in the language the guest picks, with nothing half translated.
